90yearslong: The new lieutenant gave his name as Arno Yearslong. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Arno Yearslong did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Arno Yearslong studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-R14 in the dark to learn it by heart. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Arno Yearslong helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Arno Yearslong won before reaching the end of his entry.

Arno Yearslong was hit twice at S-R14, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Clement Broccoli of the Concord (@tanghulu_broccoli). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Arno Yearslong was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. The worst has passed for Arno Yearslong. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly.
For days Arno Yearslong was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
Arno Yearslong reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R14 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Arno "Crow" Hakkinen of the Concord (@henri.hakkinen.566).

Arno Yearslong was hit in the hip at S-R14. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Valentin Coleharrison of the Concord (@coleharrison1210). No bed for Arno Yearslong. A medic cut his sleeve away, bandaged the wound, and moved on to the next stretcher.
alex_h5315: After 9 days of war, Q-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Hugo "Brick" Alex.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F1, Hugo "Brick" Alex listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Hugo "Brick" Alex was hit in the hip at Q-F1. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Edmund Combs of the Hegemony (@victor__combs). Hugo "Brick" Alex was killed at Q-F1 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Edmund Combs of the Hegemony (@victor__combs).

The House of Alex sent another. Roland Alex, uncle of Hugo "Brick" Alex, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Roland Alex wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The men have learned that Roland Alex polishes his buttons every evening. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal. A letter from home found Roland Alex before the night shift. Roland Alex folded it small and kept it close.
Roland Alex smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Casimir Therealstycx came out for a cup and was grazed.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Roland Alex aimed just below it. Edmund Combs was grazed.
Roland Alex fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F1. Clement Hanginbang was gravely wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.

The Hegemony sentry, Matthias Coop, shouted once. Roland Alex silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@dale.coop) Roland Alex joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Back from the raid, Roland Alex found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Sunday' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. Roland Alex kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
aruuki_045: After 9 days of war, Q-F11 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin "Saint" Aruuki.

Albin "Saint" Aruuki had just lit a cigarette at Q-F11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard of the Concord (@firekeyboard). News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Albin "Saint" Aruuki during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Three days with a bandage, and Albin "Saint" Aruuki is back at Q-F11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Victory at Grey Mill. Albin "Saint" Aruuki let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Tobias Polley (Concord) and Albin "Saint" Aruuki (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Drowned Farm for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Albin "Saint" Aruuki was hit in the forearm at Q-F11. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Jonas Justafungi of the Concord (@justafungi77).
Albin "Saint" Aruuki is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
A bullet grazed Albin "Saint" Aruuki's ribs at Q-F11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue of the Concord (@grebegue).
Albin "Saint" Aruuki stopped talking around midday. The medic took one look and called for a stretcher.
bark_passenger: The new lieutenant gave his name as Arno Passenger. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Arno Passenger studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked S-S6 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Wendel Melioduff reads Arno Passenger's letters from home out loud, because Arno never learned to read. Wendel leaves out the sad parts. Arno knows.
Arno Passenger was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Arno Passenger could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Arno Passenger of the Hegemony and Jakub Asdf of the Concord have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Lantern Hill for a week. Both trenches keep score. The clerk counted the names twice. Arno Passenger is number 441 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Victory at Grey Mill. Arno Passenger let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Arno Passenger lent Florian Fitness a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Arno Passenger measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Arno Passenger waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
Arno Passenger was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S6. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Henrik Rossfm of the Concord (@rossfm82).
Fever took hold of Arno Passenger overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
big_shrex: Silas "Button" Shrex walked into R-R16 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Silas "Button" Shrex folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Silas "Button" Shrex thought about a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. Victory at Grey Mill. Silas "Button" Shrex let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Silas "Button" Shrex offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
A bullet hit Silas "Button" Shrex's belt buckle at R-R16 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss of the Concord (@anjvryss).
Silas "Button" Shrex walked back up the communication trench to R-R16, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Silas "Button" Shrex carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
Silas "Button" Shrex drew the street leading to Stoneyford. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
brock_yokley: Clement "Saint" Yokley was a tailor in Esterhaus until the posters went up. He came to R-F11 with a stub of a pencil, and within a day the whole bay knew that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Clement "Saint" Yokley was number 35. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Clement "Saint" Yokley folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Clement "Saint" Yokley raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Valentin "Crow" Hodnepijumal of the Hegemony (@hodnepijumaloctu).
Clement "Saint" Yokley no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

The parcel for Clement "Saint" Yokley contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade. After the loss of Hill 304, Clement "Saint" Yokley helped stack spare sandbags at R-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Clement "Saint" Yokley has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

Clement "Saint" Yokley held the mirror while Edmund "Whistle" Es shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. The chaplains took Clement "Saint" Yokley in on a busy morning in R-F11. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

A bullet clipped Clement "Saint" Yokley's helmet at R-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). A letter from home found Clement "Saint" Yokley before the night shift. Clement "Saint" Yokley folded it small and kept it close.

Clement "Saint" Yokley took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). A single shot at R-F11. Clement "Saint" Yokley sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson).

Arno "Lucky" Yokley took the same post at R-F11 where Clement "Saint" Yokley stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. The First Wave ribbon marked Arno "Lucky" Yokley as an early volunteer. At R-F11, a newcomer asked what those first days had been like.

Arno "Lucky" Yokley fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman, grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno "Lucky" Yokley stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. The transfer made Arno "Lucky" Yokley a chaplain. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Arno "Lucky" Yokley warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move. A letter from home found Arno "Lucky" Yokley before the night shift. Arno "Lucky" Yokley folded it small and kept it close. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Arno "Lucky" Yokley watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The cook borrowed Arno "Lucky" Yokley's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Arno "Lucky" Yokley won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in R-F11. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
A newspaper reached Arno "Lucky" Yokley with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Arno "Lucky" Yokley dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Arno "Lucky" Yokley was on watch at R-F11 when the night raid hit. The men found Arno "Lucky" Yokley at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Emil "Button" Mugginsthede of the Hegemony (@mugginsthedestroyer).
The papers connected Bram "Mole" Yokley to Arno "Lucky" Yokley. The men took longer to learn Bram "Mole" Yokley's own habits, but they made the effort.
bruh1237_33: Rafael "Rabbit" Bruh joined the replacements on Day 16. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
christian.__.hensley: Dorian Hensley arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-R3 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Dorian Hensley listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Dorian Hensley ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. Victory at Grey Mill. Dorian Hensley let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Dorian Hensley fired at a movement across the wire at R-R3. The man went down: Isidor "Mole" Raptor, grazed. A letter from home reached Dorian Hensley before dusk. Dorian Hensley read it twice and slept a little easier.

Fog hid the far end of R-R3. Dorian Hensley kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. A letter from home reached Dorian Hensley before dusk. Dorian Hensley read it twice and slept a little easier.
Dorian Hensley carried Gustav Oskr's rifle all the way up to the Drowned Farm after Gustav twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Dorian Hensley waited for that to change. When it did, Ivo Sharky was badly wounded. Dawn watch. Dorian Hensley put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Ulrich Porsche, badly wounded.
The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Dorian Hensley was missing. At dawn they saw Dorian Hensley lying by the wire.
Ulrich Hensley joined R-R3 under the shadow of Dorian Hensley's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
cody_lahetta: Roland "Button" Lahetta arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lucky button and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. The new duty roster listed Roland "Button" Lahetta as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Listening post, three in the morning. Roland "Button" Lahetta heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter from home reached Roland "Button" Lahetta before dusk. Roland "Button" Lahetta read it twice and slept a little easier. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland "Button" Lahetta wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Roland "Button" Lahetta fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F2. Felix "Mud" Goat was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A letter from home reached Roland "Button" Lahetta before dusk. Roland "Button" Lahetta read it twice and slept a little easier.

Roland "Button" Lahetta (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Sorrow Copse. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Wendel Sleepyfive: 'Fair trade.' A letter from home reached Roland "Button" Lahetta before dusk. Roland "Button" Lahetta read it twice and slept a little easier.

Roland "Button" Lahetta and Jakub Asdf compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A letter from home reached Roland "Button" Lahetta before dusk. Roland "Button" Lahetta read it twice and slept a little easier.
The gun at U-F2 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Norbert Kolor, gravely wounded.
Roland "Button" Lahetta went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Dorian Procyon did not get up again. (@user_procyon)
dar_yjr: Zeno Yjr told the sergeant he was a lamplighter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Zeno Yjr thought about a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Zeno Yjr watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Zeno Yjr read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter from home reached Zeno Yjr before dusk. Zeno Yjr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno Yjr had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. A letter from home reached Zeno Yjr before dusk. Zeno Yjr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet struck Zeno Yjr below the ribs at U-F14. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. A letter from home reached Zeno Yjr before dusk. Zeno Yjr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno Yjr spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped. A letter from home reached Zeno Yjr before dusk. Zeno Yjr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno Yjr never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. There was a letter for Zeno Yjr. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Zeno Yjr laughed for the first time in days.
dewberrrryy: Hugo Dewberrrryy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 14. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The parcel for Hugo Dewberrrryy contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Hugo Dewberrrryy and Walter Taylormanme tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
easy_raider_: Teodor Raider arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pressed cornflower and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Teodor Raider watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Teodor Raider fired at a movement across the wire at R-R17. The man went down: Otto Kobold, badly wounded. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Teodor Raider folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Teodor Raider wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Teodor Raider used it. Florian Marks was grazed.
Teodor Raider's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Teodor Raider spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

Teodor Raider was hit through the stomach at R-R17. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Leopold Domgas of the Concord (@domgas_1). Teodor Raider was killed at R-R17 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Leopold Domgas of the Concord (@domgas_1).
Karel Raider put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Teodor Raider helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Karel Raider took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-R17, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Henrik "Smokes" Kobold of the Concord (@tech_kobold). Karel Raider was laid on a stretcher at the end of a long row outside the aid post. The bearers chalked a number on his boot.
ebrrrvole: Jakub Ebrrrvole signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Jakub Ebrrrvole was number 65. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Jakub Ebrrrvole received a photograph taken outside the family home. He studied the unfamiliar curtains longer than the faces. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F15. Jakub Ebrrrvole has learned to walk bent double.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub Ebrrrvole went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
A bullet clipped Jakub Ebrrrvole's helmet at R-F15 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Gideon Actioncam of the Concord (@actioncam3000).

Fever took hold of Jakub Ebrrrvole overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jakub Ebrrrvole helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jakub Ebrrrvole did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

Another member of the House of Ebrrrvole reached the line: Bastian Ebrrrvole. He asked where Jakub Ebrrrvole had slept, then chose a different corner. Volunteer number 65. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Bastian Ebrrrvole's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

During a lull at the Sunken Road, Bastian Ebrrrvole called across from the Hegemony line. Bastian "Lucky" Vpy answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Bastian Ebrrrvole saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F15 and fired once. Gideon Actioncam was grazed.
Bastian Ebrrrvole reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord (@le.mrsh_).

The medic looked at Bastian Ebrrrvole's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F15. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bastian Ebrrrvole watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet went through Bastian Ebrrrvole's upper arm at R-F15 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Norbert "Mole" Yanis of the Concord (@yanis_ey522). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Bastian Ebrrrvole shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Bastian Ebrrrvole. He was asleep before they set him down.
Bastian Ebrrrvole spent the day in bed with his leg propped up. The orderly changed the dressing and said it was healing the way it should.
Bastian Ebrrrvole held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Florian Ebrrrvole arrived carrying the family name of Bastian Ebrrrvole. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-F15. Florian Ebrrrvole saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Ulrich Gpt was grazed.

A bullet hit Florian Ebrrrvole in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F15. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Severin Masterofecli of the Concord (@masterofeclipse). Florian Ebrrrvole was killed outright at R-F15, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Severin Masterofecli of the Concord (@masterofeclipse).
The papers say Clement Ebrrrvole. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Florian Ebrrrvole's eyes. Nobody in R-F15 argues.
franciszekhaluch: Roland Franciszekha stepped off the supply cart at V-F7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. Grey Mill is lost. Roland Franciszekha heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Roland Franciszekha pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Franciszekha. Roland Franciszekha read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Roland Franciszekha measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

Roland Franciszekha was hit in the forearm at V-F7. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Yann "Smokes" Ollybats of the Hegemony (@ollybats).

Roland Franciszekha came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Franciszekha. Roland Franciszekha read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Roland Franciszekha hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.
jackmdunn06: Isidor Jackmdunn came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Isidor Jackmdunn was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Isidor Jackmdunn asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
A flare lit Blackwater Canal like noon. Isidor Jackmdunn counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Isidor Jackmdunn kept the tin. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Isidor Jackmdunn shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Jackmdunn fired at a movement across the wire at S-F11. The man went down: Edmund Somosmagios, badly wounded.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Isidor Jackmdunn in the open at S-F11. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak). Isidor Jackmdunn looked over the parapet at S-F11 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).

A letter came with Marek Jackmdunn: "I am Isidor Jackmdunn's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Volunteer number 26. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Marek Jackmdunn's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'

Oskar Pbscn cut Marek Jackmdunn's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Marek Jackmdunn stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A muddy dog crawled into S-F11 through the wire. Marek Jackmdunn gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Biscuit.
Marek Jackmdunn received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Marek Jackmdunn's hands still remember being a ferryman's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Biscuit has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Marek Jackmdunn is very proud. Biscuit is mainly proud of the biscuits.

Marek Jackmdunn threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Silas Menezes was down and screaming for a medic. (@julio.menezes921) The Hegemony sentry, Silas Zdsh, shouted once. Marek Jackmdunn silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@reza_zdsh) After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Marek Jackmdunn helped stack spare sandbags at S-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Marek Jackmdunn heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Marek Jackmdunn looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F11 and grazed Marek Jackmdunn's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke of the Hegemony (@broeringluke).
The medics cleaned Marek Jackmdunn's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F11.

Marek Jackmdunn was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Yann Somosmagios of the Hegemony (@somosmagios.bo).
Marek Jackmdunn rejoined the squad at S-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

The whole squad at S-F11 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Marek Jackmdunn's bullet that found Valentin Jul, badly wounded. Marek Jackmdunn lay buried at S-F11 for long minutes before anyone could dig him out. Now every minute counts. A shell burst in the trench at S-F11. The men around Marek Jackmdunn were thrown aside and lived. Marek Jackmdunn took the worst of it and was killed at once.
The House of Jackmdunn sent another. Quentin "Brick" Jackmdunn, uncle of Marek Jackmdunn, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
jacob.burnhill: In Northwick, Silas "Parson" Burnhill was a medical student. In P-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a medical student again. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Silas "Parson" Burnhill during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A loose thread in Silas "Parson" Burnhill's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

Silas "Parson" Burnhill let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Jonas Art was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Silas "Parson" Burnhill before dusk. Silas "Parson" Burnhill read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wind kept turning the pages of Silas "Parson" Burnhill's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink. A letter from home reached Silas "Parson" Burnhill before dusk. Silas "Parson" Burnhill read it twice and slept a little easier.
Silas "Parson" Burnhill had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Arno Pars was badly wounded.

Silas "Parson" Burnhill offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter for Silas "Parson" Burnhill came with a pressed flower inside. Silas "Parson" Burnhill showed the flower to nobody.
jakub.prokes: After 3 days of war, S-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Albin Prokes.

Albin Prokes (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple (Concord) at the Sunken Road. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Albin Prokes's helmet at S-F1 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Albin Prokes watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Albin Prokes no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Albin Prokes invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Albin Prokes said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A bullet went through Albin Prokes's sleeve at S-F1 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Quentin Underthrone of the Concord (@underthrone99).

The medic looked at Albin Prokes's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F1. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Albin Prokes could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Albin Prokes watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin Prokes is number 296. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Albin Prokes walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Albin Prokes had Walter "Saint" Williemcminn of the Concord in the sights at Blackwater Canal for a long second. Walter "Saint" Williemcminn was lighting a pipe. Albin Prokes let the match burn all the way down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Albin Prokes received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit Albin Prokes's belt buckle at S-F1 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Norbert Rottenr of the Concord (@rottenr0be). Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Prokes. Albin Prokes read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit Albin Prokes in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F1. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam of the Concord (@henrywestgaming1812). A single shot at S-F1. Albin Prokes sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam of the Concord (@henrywestgaming1812).

The papers say Zeno Prokes. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Albin Prokes's eyes. Nobody in S-F1 argues. Orders came through: Zeno Prokes is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a photograph gone soft at the edges.

Zeno Prokes bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. The runner said a letter for Zeno Prokes had come up with the ammunition. Zeno Prokes went to get it before the ammunition.
justin.earley.73: By the time Matthias Earley reached R-S13, the war was 7 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Matthias Earley cut Felix Landon's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Earley. Matthias Earley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The parcel for Matthias Earley contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias Earley wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A rat stole Matthias Earley's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Matthias Earley is number 492. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-S13, Matthias Earley listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Officers came to inspect R-S13. Matthias Earley polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Matthias Earley put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
A stretcher party needed the passage. Matthias Earley backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed.
Matthias Earley received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Matthias Earley fixed the strap on Henrik Jns's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
martin.briton: Bram Briton was a glassblower in Tannenfeld until the posters went up. He came to R-C1 with a bullet that missed him, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bram Briton helped stack spare sandbags at R-C1. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Bram Briton fired once through the steel loophole at R-C1 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Konrad "Mole" Paulus was gravely wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Bram Briton is number 789 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Bram Briton wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Bram Briton felt a hard tug at his hip at R-C1. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____).
Bram Briton came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Bram Briton let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Rafael Szy was grazed.

Bram Briton waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Emil "Tin" Bangarang did, and was gravely wounded. A bullet found Bram Briton at R-C1, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Tobias Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21). A single shot at R-C1. Bram Briton sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Tobias Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21).
Benedikt Briton asked about Bram Briton on arriving at R-C1. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-C1. Benedikt Briton saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin was badly wounded.
nightrunner289: Walter Nightrunner arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in S-R8 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-R8, Walter Nightrunner listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet grazed Walter Nightrunner's ribs at S-R8. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Valentin "Whistle" Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon). The clerk counted the names twice. Walter Nightrunner is number 821 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Walter Nightrunner helped stack spare sandbags at S-R8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Walter Nightrunner no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dawn watch. Walter Nightrunner put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Ivo Cko, grazed.
Across from S-R8, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Walter Nightrunner saw it. Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex was grazed.
Walter Nightrunner saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R8 and fired once. Lucien Aggiomarco was grazed.

Walter Nightrunner fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Jonas Team was badly wounded. Walter Nightrunner was blown off the fire step at S-R8. He is alive, barely, and the bearers are carrying him back as fast as they can.
oorah961: Quentin Oorah joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Quentin Oorah did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Quentin Oorah. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Quentin Oorah during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Quentin Oorah got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Quentin Oorah worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Quentin Oorah wrote back to Helene and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.

The whole squad at S-R1 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Quentin Oorah's bullet that found Benedikt Azok, gravely wounded. Across from S-R1, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Quentin Oorah saw it. Tobias Aamir was grazed.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Quentin Oorah shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Zeno "Brick" Peter, was badly wounded. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R1 and grazed Quentin Oorah's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Pavel Saturdaynigh of the Concord (@saturdaynightinafieldrunning).
somebodynamednile: The quartermaster asked Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Teodor Tommy was badly wounded. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back.

Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Dietrich Drak of the Hegemony (@glauber.drak).
The wound on Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Walter Keegan, grazed.
Leopold "Shadow" Somebodyname sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour.
trentonfulis: Day 11. The corporal put Teodor Trentonfulis beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In N-F13, Teodor Trentonfulis listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Teodor Trentonfulis accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
A letter reached Teodor Trentonfulis from Brennmoor. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
The trench wall shook against Teodor Trentonfulis's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
A supply man offered Teodor Trentonfulis a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Teodor Trentonfulis put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
varyk_leh: "You're late," said the corporal when Leopold "Whistle" Leh arrived on Day 6. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Zeno "Ghost" Crackhead held the mirror while Leopold "Whistle" Leh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Leopold "Whistle" Leh sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. A letter from home reached Leopold "Whistle" Leh before dusk. Leopold "Whistle" Leh read it twice and slept a little easier.
Someone asked Leopold "Whistle" Leh to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Whistle" Leh stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Leopold "Whistle" Leh's hands still remember being a coal miner's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Leopold "Whistle" Leh answered to number 462. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-S6, Leopold "Whistle" Leh listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
During a lull at Hill 304, Leopold "Whistle" Leh called across from the Concord line. Tobias Jeeves answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The order named Leopold "Whistle" Leh as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.
Leopold "Whistle" Leh found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a woman in a white dress, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.

Leopold "Whistle" Leh was hit through the chest at S-S6. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Bram Roma of the Hegemony (@vitto_roma07). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Leopold "Whistle" Leh was carried in at last. The surgeon worked on Leopold "Whistle" Leh until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
The papers connected Henrik "Saint" Leh to Leopold "Whistle" Leh. The men took longer to learn Henrik "Saint" Leh's own habits, but they made the effort.

A bullet went into Henrik "Saint" Leh's chest just under the heart at S-S6. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Henrik "Brick" Dingle of the Hegemony (@d.colorado_dingle). Henrik "Saint" Leh was killed on watch at S-S6. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Henrik "Brick" Dingle of the Hegemony (@d.colorado_dingle).
The papers say Bram Leh. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Henrik "Saint" Leh's eyes. Nobody in S-S6 argues.
wolfmanantony: Nils Wolfmananton came from Northwick, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
A bullet went through Nils Wolfmananton's sleeve at S-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks of the Concord (@csllgaks).

The medics cleaned Nils Wolfmananton's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F8. The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton has learned to walk bent double.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F8. Nils Wolfmananton was the only one they could still help, and only just. Nils Wolfmananton died in the hospital bed despite everything the surgeon tried. a rosary of rough beads was in his hand at the end.
Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton arrived carrying the family name of Nils Wolfmananton. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

The blast lifted Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton off his feet at S-F8. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A bullet found Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton at S-F8, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Zeno "Shadow" Maximus of the Concord (@sleetius_maximus). Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.

A letter came with Dietrich Wolfmananton: "I am Yann "Smokes" Wolfmananton's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Orders assigned Dietrich Wolfmananton to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Dawn watch. Dietrich Wolfmananton put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Zeno "Shadow" Maximus, badly wounded. A bullet clipped Dietrich Wolfmananton's helmet at S-F8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy). Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Wolfmananton was carrying water up to S-F8 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Dietrich Wolfmananton did not. Shot by Otto Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy). Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Wolfmananton spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Dietrich Wolfmananton recovered anyway and is back at S-F8. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Dietrich Wolfmananton let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Dietrich Wolfmananton aimed just below it. Tobias Connordavids was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dietrich Wolfmananton answered to number 114. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Dietrich Wolfmananton shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Dietrich Wolfmananton fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Ivo "Crow" Natecartw was grazed trying to cross it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Wolfmananton pulled Matthias "Doc" Gaita out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Mail came up the line with a letter for Dietrich Wolfmananton. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Dietrich Wolfmananton won before reaching the end of his entry.
Dietrich Wolfmananton offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

Dietrich Wolfmananton fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Matthias "Shadow" Deakins did not get to reply at all, grazed. A letter from home reached Dietrich Wolfmananton before dusk. Dietrich Wolfmananton read it twice and slept a little easier.
